name: wait-restored
expression: new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{const check=()=>{if(document.querySelector('.live-assistant.is-open')&&document.querySelector('.rail-assistant-toggle')&&document.querySelector('.workspace-rails')?.getAttribute('data-pane')==='sheets'){observer.disconnect();clearTimeout(timer);resolve(true)}};const observer=new MutationObserver(check);observer.observe(document.body,{subtree:true,childList:true,attributes:true});const timer=setTimeout(()=>{observer.disconnect();reject(Error('Drawings assistant not restored'))},6000);check();})
